spec.name: Lumen Bloom
spec.description: A tall bioluminescent alien plant from Pandora: a pale spiral stalk rising from glowing roots into an arching crown of long leaves and a large translucent bud that lights the model from inside.
spec.layout: Front to back: a low mound of glowing root knobs and small ground sprouts fills the footprint (lowest points at y = 0, floor: true). From its centre a smooth pale-teal stalk rises straight and slightly spiral, ringed with collar sheaths, to about y = 1.7 where it leans back a little. From the stalk's upper half, six long arching leaf stems fan out around it (two facing +Z, two -Z, two sideways), each carrying a broad tapered leaf that droops toward the ground, edges lined with glowing dots. At the top the stalk splits into a closed tulip-shaped bud of thick waxy petals, violet on the outside with cream inner rims, open a few centimetres at its mouth where a cluster of filament stamens with glowing tips reaches out and up. Fine curling tendrils sprout from leaf axils and the bud base, spiralling outward, each tipped with a small glowing bead. The style is Avatar bioluminescence: desaturated deep teal-green body surfaces, saturated violet-magenta and cyan only on the glowing elements, cream on leaf undersides and bud rims; every glow part is built as its own small parts so the light reads as dotted veins, tip beads and rim lines, not one big emissive blob. Silhouette is a fountain: narrow glowing core, wide leaf skirt, narrow bright bud cap.

parts.builds: The ground piece: a low smooth mound of dark soil about 0.9 m across and 0.16 m tall at centre, plus a ring of 8-10 thick gnarled root knuckles emerging from the soil and re-entering it (swept tubes, rootBark, tapering), each with 1-2 glowing cyan veins as thin swept lines lying on the root surface and a small glowing bead at the knuckle tip. Between roots, 6-9 small ground sprouts: tiny stalks 8-16 cm tall with two or three small teardrop leaves (extruded outlines), leafUnder colour with a glowPink dot on each tip, and a faint moss patch (flat discs) where roots meet soil. Lowest points at y = 0.
parts.attaches: Grows out of groundCenter and wraps around stalkBase; root knuckles visually merge into the stalk's lower flare.

parts.builds: The main stem: a swept tube from stalkBase at [0, 0.12, 0] up to crownShoulder at [0, 1.7, 0.08], radius tapering from 0.11 at the base (with a widened flare skirt into the mound) through 0.07 mid-stalk to 0.05 at the top, path curving very slightly back and then leaning toward +Z. Stalk colour with stalkShade on the shaded side. Around the stem, 5-6 horizontal collar sheaths (short flared rings, sheath colour) at intervals of about 0.3 m, each with a thin glowCyan rim line on its lower edge and a single glowPink vein dot. A vertical dotted line of tiny glowCyan studs (8-12) runs up the +Z face of the stem between sheaths. The stem ends at budBase where it thickens into a small urn-shaped calyx (lathe, petalDeep) that the bud sits in, ringed with 4 small sepals curling down (extruded, leafEdge with glowCyan tips).
parts.attaches: Base meets groundCenter/roots at stalkBase; top ends at crownShoulder and hands off to the bud at budBase; leaf stems sprout from leafRing on its upper half (small bulge sockets where each stem leaves).

parts.builds: Six arching stems with leaves. Each stem is a swept tube from its own stem* joint, curving out and down in a fountain arc (radius 0.03 tapering to 0.016), leafTop colour with a stalkShade stripe. Each carries one broad leaf: an extruded tapered blade 0.55-0.8 m long, 0.16-0.24 m wide at its widest, thinning to a point, mounted mid-stem and drooping, leafTop on the upper face with leafUnder visible on the drooping underside, leafEdge outline built as a thin rim part along the blade silhouette. Along each leaf's midrib, a row of 5-7 paired glowCyan vein dots (small discs seated on the surface), and a chain of 3-5 tiny glowPink beads along the outer drooping tip. At each stem's base, a small sheath-coloured socket cone and one curling tendril: a thin swept spiral 0.3-0.5 m long ending in a glowViolet bead, tip glowing. The two +Z leaves sit lowest and furthest forward, the -Z pair highest and back, the side pair midway, so the fan reads in depth.
parts.attaches: All six stems root at their stem* joints on leafRing around stalkMid; leaf tips hang toward but do not touch the root mound below (clearance 5-10 cm).

parts.builds: The flower head, the hero piece. At budBase a bud of 6 thick waxy petals closes into a tulip shape about 0.34 m tall and 0.3 m across at its widest: each petal a curved extruded shell, petalViolet outside, petalDeep in the vertical creases between petals (built as narrow darker strips seated in the seams), each petal's outer face carrying 2-3 branching glowPink vein lines that follow the petal curve, and its upper rim edged with a glowing cream band (budInner) that reads as the light leaking around the closed mouth. The bud's mouth (at jaw) gapes open about 20 degrees, showing budInner petals inside lit bright. From the mouth, 9-12 stamens: thin swept filaments (stamen) fanning up and outward 0.2-0.35 m, each tipped with a teardrop anther in glowCyan with a tiny beadCore highlight disc; three central stamens are taller and end in glowPink anthers. A cluster of 4-5 short curling tendrils spirals out from the bud's calyx seam, each with a small glowViolet bead tip. The whole bud area is the brightest point of the model: rim bands, veins, anthers and bead tips all built as separate glowing parts.
parts.attaches: Sits in the calyx at budBase on top of stalkTrunk; its tendrils and stamen tips reach outward above the leafCrown without touching it.

calls.reasoning:
I'm writing a spec JSON for a bioluminescent alien plant, Avatar (Pandora) style. Six arms of spiral petals, glowing tendrils, at night — a giant glowing plant on mossy ground, no other scenery. Big glowing seed pod at the top, ring of bioluminescent stamens.

size: height ~2.6 m — glowing plant 2.4 tall, maybe 2.6. Width 1.6, depth 1.6.

Palette: deep teal-green stalk, magenta/violet bioluminescent, cyan glow, cream, dark soil. Avatar flora: teal, purple, pink, bioluminescent accents.

Parts: base/stalk (root), ground mound (floor), six arching leaf stems, top bloom (glowing bud with petals), glowing tendrils/vines, small... but brief says plant only, no scenery — small ground moss around base is fine as part of the plant's base (roots). 5-6 parts.
